<!-- Generated by scripts/build.py: Claude zh-Hant terminology -->
In zh-Hant UI copy and responses, translate these terms exactly as listed:

- Claude Code → Claude Code. Product name. Keep in English in every language, without quotation marks.
- Cowork → Cowork. Product name. Keep in English.
- Remote Control → Remote Control. Keep in English when capitalized as the feature name. Translate lowercase “remote control” used descriptively.
- MCP / MCP server → MCP 伺服器. Keep the abbreviation MCP; translate “server”.
- desktop app → 桌面應用程式. Keep Claude Desktop and Claude Code for Desktop in English when used as names.
- Session → 工作階段. A unit of work in Claude Code and Cowork. zh-Hans: session = 会话, chat and conversation = 对话; never mix them.
- Chat / Conversation → 對話. zh-Hans uses 对话 for both chat and conversation, never 聊天. ja-JP and ko-KR: chat = チャット / 채팅, conversation = 会話 / 대화.
- Side Chat → 側邊對話
- Skill → Skill. zh-Hans and zh-Hant keep Skill in English, never 技能. ja-JP uses the plural Skills.
- Artifact → 成品. Handled differently per language: zh-Hans keeps Artifact, zh-Hant uses 成品, ja-JP keeps Artifacts, ko-KR transliterates as 아티팩트.
- Extension → 擴充功能. Distinct from Plugin. zh-Hans: Extension = 扩展, Plugin = 插件; never use 插件 for Extension.
- Computer use → 電腦操作. zh-Hans mostly uses 计算机使用: 21 against 2 for 电脑操作.
- Quick Entry → 快速輸入. Translated in menus and settings; some web strings still keep Quick Entry.
- Developer / Developer mode → 開發人員
- Model → 模型. Never translate model names such as Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.
- Turn → 回合. zh-Hans uses 轮: 轮到您了, 上一轮失败, 轮次失败.
- Folder → 資料夾. ja-JP mixes フォルダ and フォルダー; フォルダ is the majority. Translate directory separately, e.g. zh-Hans 目录.
- Workspace → 工作區
- Repository → 儲存庫
- Worktree → 工作樹. The git worktree concept.
- Git origin → Git 來源. Official translations are inconsistent; the recommendation follows the majority.
- Sign in / Log in → 登入. ja-JP keeps the distinction: sign in = サインイン, log in = ログイン.
- Organization / Admin → 組織 / 管理員
- Credentials → 憑證
- Plan → 方案. The subscription tier, such as Pro or Max. Distinct from plan mode, e.g. zh-Hans 套餐 versus 计划模式.
- Usage / Usage limits → 使用量（usage limits → 使用量限制）
- Pin / Pinned → 固定（列表置頂 → 釘選）. Pinning an item to the top of a list: zh-Hans 置顶, zh-Hant 釘選, ja-JP ピン留め. Locking a setting, such as a Git origin: zh-Hans 固定.
- Trust / Trusted → 信任. trusted folder = zh-Hans 受信任的文件夹.
- Allow / Allowed → 允許
- Approve / Approved → 核准
- this computer → 電腦. zh-Hans splits 计算机 and 电脑 almost evenly; 计算机 appears mostly with Computer use. Use 电脑 for the device.
- Phone → 手機
- Cloud → 雲端. Keep names such as Google Cloud.
- Settings → 設定
- Configuration / Config → 設定. zh-Hans distinguishes settings = 设置 and config = 配置.
- Window → 視窗
- Terminal → 終端機
- Connect / Connected / Connection → 連線（動作：連接）
- Restart → 重新啟動. ko-KR mostly uses 다시 시작, sometimes 재시작.
- Update → 更新. ja-JP uses 更新 in general and アップデート mainly for app version updates.
- Debug / Log → 偵錯 / 記錄. zh-Hant mixes 偵錯 and 除錯; 偵錯 is the majority.
- Dictation → 聽寫
